bug.title: /verify with a version id loops forever on the manifest request in production builds
bug.symptoms: Typing sch:ayy7-sc3b-4mze/v1 (or opening /verify?id=...) leaves the panel on "Checking... Loading the files signed for ..." for any dropped file; the page re-renders ~1,800 times a second and sends GET /v1/papers/{id}/v/1/manifest ~1,700 times a second, each cancelled by the next (status 0); the same URL answers 200 from curl In the production bundle, useFileCheck's default `loadManifest` is an inline arrow (the minifier inlined the single-use module constant loadVersionManifest), so its identity changes every render and the effect whose dependencies include it re-runs every render; unit tests on source cannot reproduce it The Playwright suite never opens /verify with an id, so e2e 31/31 stayed green
bug.reproduction_steps: Production build (next build + next start, next 16.4.6): open /verify?id=sch:{seeded id}/v1, wrap window.fetch to count manifest calls for 1 s (~1,700); journey 02 step 7 (screenshots/02-search-and-discover/07a-verify-page-id-entered.png, 07b-verify-with-id-stuck-checking.png, 07c-verify-unrelated-with-id-stuck.png)
bug.expected: The manifest effect and the content-versions effect depend only on values (schId, file cid, attempt), never on loader function identity: loaders are read through a ref updated each render (latest-callback pattern), so an inline or re-created loader never restarts a request; the manifest is requested once per id and per retry; a unit test re-renders the hook with a new loader function each render and asserts one request; a Playwright test on the production build opens /verify?id={seeded version}, counts manifest requests over 2 s (at most 1), drops the version's main.pdf and sees the match verdict, and drops an unrelated file and sees the mismatch verdict; the same Playwright file visits the main public routes (/, a paper page and its tabs, /verify, /network, /search, /c/cs.AI) and asserts no API path is requested more than 5 times within 3 s of load
bug.actual: The check never finishes; the node is flooded with requests

bug.title: Appeal panel polish: two post appeals read identically; overturn labelled "Moderation outcome"; changing a vote loses the reasons; /mod summary stale after the deciding vote
bug.symptoms: A panellist on two appeals about posts on the same paper sees two identical attention items and notices ("Vote on the appeal of a hidden post on "{title}" by 3 Dec 2026"); only the /mod cards tell them apart The upheld notice is labelled "Appeal outcome" but an overturned appeal reaches the appellant as the restoration notice labelled "Moderation outcome" "Change my vote" can never pre-fill the member's reasons (the appeal detail returns viewer_vote and viewer_voted_at but not the reasons) and shows "This server did not send the reasons you gave before..." Right after the deciding vote the Appeals summary still reads "1 appeal waiting for a panel · 0 decided" while the card says "Decided by the panel" (a reload fixes it)
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 05 step 6 (screenshots/05-follow-search-notify/06a-solheim-attention-appeal-panel.png); journey 07 step 8 (08h vs 08l, 08i); journey 11 step 11 (screenshots/11-moderation-hold-and-appeal/11b-deciding-vote.png)
bug.expected: Post appeal panel items and notices quote the start of the hidden post ('Vote on the appeal of a hidden post on "{title}" ("{excerpt}...") by 3 Dec 2026') for seated members, who may see the excerpt; a restoration that answers an appeal is labelled "Appeal outcome" on the dashboard, like the upheld notice; the appeal detail returns the viewer's own recorded reasons (viewer_reasons) to that seated member only, and "Change my vote" pre-fills them; the Appeals summary counts update in the same render as the card when a vote decides the panel

bug.title: /me/security shows the passkey creation day in UTC without saying so
bug.symptoms: A passkey created at about 06:20 on 19 Nov (GMT+11) is listed as "Passkey created 18 Nov 2026"; formatDay in dashboard/security.ts formats in UTC and strips the " UTC" suffix (security-page.tsx line 220)
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 03 step 5 in a browser east of UTC (screenshots/03-new-member-onboarding/05a-security.png)
bug.expected: Calendar days on /me/security use the shared ui-kit date helpers in the reader's zone; times that stay in UTC keep their "UTC" label; tests run in a non-UTC zone
